WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.entrystat,
    AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_images
  FROM scanenvironment se
  INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.entrystat
),
overall_image_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_images) as image_mean
  FROM status_averages
)
SELECT
  sa.entrystat,
  sa.avg_temp,
  sa.avg_images,
  sa.avg_images - oim.image_mean as image_diff
FROM status_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_image_mean oim;
